caseno: Appeal from Original Decree (FA) No. 76 of 1998.
lawyer:
Zahedul Bari, Advocate ----- For the Appellant. 
Md Amanullah, Advocate ----- For the Respondents.
parties:
Rafia Begum   ------ Plaintiff-Appellant
vs
Afroza Bewa and others   ------ Defendants- Respondents
full_judgment:
AKM Fazlur Rahman J : This appeal at the instance of the plaintiff-appellant is directed against the judgment and decree dated 4-2-1998 passed by the learned Subordinate Judge, Second Court, Bogra in Other Class Suit No. 2 of 1994 dismissing the suit. 

 6. Being aggrieved by that judgment and decree of dismissal of the suit the appellant preferred this appeal. The appeal has been contested by the respondents. 

 7. Mr Zahedul Bari, the learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the appellants, has made submission supporting appeal and assailing the judgment and decree appealed from. He has submitted that admittedly the appellant is in possession of the suit land. That appellant's prayer for giving her a chance to adduce further evidence was refused by the trial Court. For that the suit should be sent bank on remand for retrial giving her an opportunity to adduce further evidence. 

 8. Mr Amanullah the learned Advocate appearing on behalf of the respondents, has made submission opposing the appeal and supporting the impugned judgment and decree. He has submitted that the appellant failed to avail the opportunity given to her for adducing further evidence in proving the alleged oral gift and, as such, there is no ground of sending the suit on remand for retrial setting aside the impugned judgment and decree. According to him, the suit has been rightly dismissed due to the failure of the appellant to prove her title in the suit land and there is no reason of interfering with the impugned judgment and decree, 

 14. In the result, the appeal is dismissed on contest without any order as to the cost. The judgment and decree appealed from is hereby affirmed.
